items.title: Salesforce Sinks as S&P Cuts Its Rating to A on Deals and a $25 Billion Buyback
items.summary: Key TakeawaysS&P cut Salesforce’s credit rating to A from A+ last week, citing rising acquisition activity and shareholder returns, while keeping a stable outlook. Salesforce agreed to buy Braze for about $5.

items.title: Palantir Rises 5%, Snowflake Up 6% as AI Stocks Rebound After Market Was “Freaking Out”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysPalantir rose 5% today with no news of its own, as Cloudflare, Snowflake and other AI stocks rebounded from last week’s selloff. That selloff came after a quarter in which Palantir’s revenue grew 96%.
